newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-MARTIN RATED DOUBTFUL OPEN STARTER.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MARTIN RATED DOUBTFUL OPEN STARTER.

text.p: American Todd Martin has withdrawn from next week's ATP Tour event in Sydney, raising doubts over whether he will play in the Australian Open later this month, a tournament official said on Saturday.

Martin, a losing finalist to compatriot Pete Sampras in the Melbourne grand slam three years ago, has been sidelined by tendonitis in his right shin, Sydney International tournament director Barry Masters said.
"This is really unfortunate for him because in addition to missing the Sydney International, he will be out of action for a few weeks," Masters said.
Martin, the world number 12 and defending Sydney International champion, said in a statement: "I really like playing in Sydney and...hopefully I'll be back next year."
The Australian Open, the first grand slam of the year, is being held in Melbourne between January 13-26.
